fields.text: NCIA is a joke! Boards say my flight is at Gate A1. I walked to A1 and it's empty. App says A12. Now I'm gonna miss my flight! #Fail #NCIA #Cleveland
fields.attachedImageBrief: A photo taken inside the terminal showing a FIDS screen listing SX 1245 to Atlanta, Gate A1, ON TIME next to an empty gate area
fields.attachedImageAlt: Departures screen next to an empty gate
